senses.definition: to move or handle something heavy or awkward with a lot of physical effort

examples.en: He wrestled the heavy wooden box into the back of the truck.
examples.vi: Anh ấy đã gồng mình chuyển chiếc hộp gỗ nặng vào thùng xe tải.

engage in deep thought, consideration, or debate
to move in a twisting or contorted motion, (especially when struggling)

vi_block: Vật lộn với, chiến đấu chống, chống lại.

wiktionary.gloss: To take part in (a wrestling bout or match).
Sometimes followed by down: to contend with or move (someone) into or out of a position by grappling; also, to overcome (someone) by grappling.

examples: I couldn't wrestle the trunk down the hall.
wiktionary.gloss: To move or manipulate (something) using physical effort, usually with some difficulty or opposition.
To engage in (a contest or struggle).
To throw down (a calf or other livestock animal) for branding.
To grapple or otherwise contend with an opponent in order to throw or force them to the ground, chiefly as a sport or in unarmed combat.
Followed by with: to move or manipulate something using physical effort, usually with some difficulty or opposition.
To make one's way or move with some difficulty or effort.
Followed by against or with: to contend, to struggle; to exert effort, to strive.

blocks.etymology: The verb is derived from Middle English wrestlen, wrastlen (“to engage in grappling combat or sport, struggle, wrestle; to twist and turn, squirm, wriggle, writhe; (figurative) to contend, grapple with, struggle”), from Old English wrǣstlian (“to wrestle”), a frequentative form of wrǣstan (“to twist, wrest”), from Proto-Germanic *wraistijaną (“to turn; to twist, wrest”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *wreyt- (“to twist”). By surface analysis, wrest + -le (frequentative suffix). Probably related to wraxle (UK, dialectal, archaic). The noun is derived from the verb.

senses.definition: a physical fight or match in which two people hold and try to throw each other

examples.en: He challenged his brother to a friendly wrestle on the carpet.
examples.vi: Cậu ấy rủ anh trai đấu vật vui vẻ trên tấm thảm.

senses.vi: cuộc đấu vật; trận đấu vật

senses.definition: a difficult struggle or effort to deal with a problem or achieve something

examples.en: Finding a cheap apartment in the capital was a constant wrestle.
examples.vi: Tìm một căn hộ giá rẻ ở thủ đô là một cuộc vật lộn không ngừng.

senses.vi: sự vật lộn; cuộc đấu tranh gay go

thesaurus.definition: the act of engaging in close hand-to-hand combat

vi_block: Sự vật lộn; cuộc đấu tranh gay go.

wiktionary.gloss: A fight or struggle between people during which they grapple or otherwise contend with each other in order to throw or force their opponent to the ground, chiefly as a sport or in unarmed combat.
A situation in which people compete with each other; a contest, a struggle.
The action of contending or struggling.

idioms.gloss: To stand with the lateral side of one's (usually right) foot touching the lateral side of his opponent's (right) foot and with his (right) hand clasping his opponent's, and to attempt to force his opponent to lose balance to the extent the latter's (right) foot moves even as his opponent does the same to him.
To engage in a struggle with an opponent that benefits from the struggle even without winning it.
To French kiss; see tongue wrestling.

phrasal_verbs.gloss: To agonize over (something); to debate a quandary or endeavor to come to a conclusion about a difficult issue.
